Harbourline Freight Depot Operations Manual. This manual describes every depot in the Harbourline Freight network. Each depot has its own section, identified by a depot code, which names the depot manager and sets out the canteen hours, staff shuttle, parking, fire assembly point, dock doors, same-day dispatch cut-off, cold storage range and security desk extension for that depot. This edition covers 806 depots.


1. Cobalt Ford depot (HD-00001)

The Cobalt Ford depot (HD-00001) in Phnom Penh, Cambodia is managed by Chloe Goh, who is the first point of contact for access passes, building issues and local safety arrangements. New joiners receive a site induction on their first morning, before they are allowed onto the warehouse floor.

The canteen at HD-00001 is open from 06:15 to 20:30 on working days and accepts the staff meal card. A free shuttle bus leaves the nearest station at 06:15 for the early shift and again eight hours later for the late shift.

There are 331 parking spaces at HD-00001, allocated on a first-come basis; those nearest the entrance are reserved for visitors and for colleagues with reduced mobility. If the fire alarm sounds, leave by the nearest exit and go to the assembly point, which is the lorry holding bay.

The depot has 60 dock doors and 33 forklift trucks. The same-day dispatch cut-off at HD-00001 is 13:00; orders released to the floor after that time are dispatched on the next working day.

Cold storage is held at 0 to 4 degrees Celsius. The security desk at HD-00001 can be reached on extension 7856 at any hour, and safety shoes and a high-visibility vest must be worn at all times in the warehouse.
